## Lab 07 Assignment - Group 20

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)  # devtools::install_github("tidymodels/broom")
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% # retain only numeric columns
  prcomp(scale = TRUE) # do PCA on scaled data

pca_fit
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% # retain only numeric columns
  scale() %>% # scale data
  prcomp() # do PCA

pca_fit
```

## PLOT 2 - Dimitra

```{r}
library(ggcorrplot)

biopsy_data <- biopsy |> 
  select(where(is.numeric))
corr_matrix <- cor(biopsy_data)
ggcorrplot(corr_matrix,
           hc.order = TRUE,
           type = "lower",
           lab = TRUE,
           lab_size = 3, 
           title = "Correlation Between the Biopsy Variables",
           legend.title = "Correlation") +
  labs(caption = "Data from the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Database") 
```
